description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grain activation and deactivation lifecycle, verifying correct behavior for activation, deactivation, reactivation, error handling, and special scenarios like long-running tasks and constructor exceptions.

classes.name: GrainActivateDeactivateTests
classes.description: Unit test class for validating the lifecycle behaviors (activation, deactivation, reactivation, error handling) of Orleans grains.

methods.name: CheckNumActivateDeactivateCalls
methods.description: Verifies the number of activation and deactivation calls and their corresponding activation data.

methods.name: AssertIsNotInvalidOperationException
methods.description: Asserts that the exception is not an InvalidOperationException and contains an expected message substring.
